generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor at least one work pertaining to the Supply & Erection / Erection / mechanical maintenance works of ash handling in any thermal power plants of capacity 500 MW & above.

The bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above work in a single work order of value not less than Rs.13.17 Lakhs in the preceding FIVE (05) years. The bidder shall upload the scanned copy of work order and corresponding proof of completion certificate from KPCL/NTPC/any SEBI/Govt. Organisation/reputed private organization issued by competent authority.

The bidder in his name should have average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.26.34 lakhs or more achieved in any two years of the preceding FIVE financial years. The bidder should upload the scanned copy of audited turn over certificate including profit and loss account for preceding five completed financial years countersigned by charted accountant as documentary evidence.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/termination of their contract in KPCL/government or any other utility and have not been blacklisted for participation in tender issued by KPCL or government or any other utility in India during the past 10 years.

Declaration by the bidder that he has studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement.
Declaration by the bidder that he has quoted the prices exclusive GST.
